note: HSK 1 reading rounds in the 新版HSK (2025-12) format, Mainland edition (Simplified, Mainland wording; owner's plan 2026-10-30): 第一部分 看句子配图 ×5, 第二部分 问答配对 ×5, 第三部分 选词填空 ×5, 第四部分 读句子回答问题 (3 options) ×5. Original texts. Pictures: data/reading/img/zh/<pic.f>.webp.

questions.zh: 「我很喜歡看書」：B 是坐在沙發上看書的女孩。
questions.en: "I really like reading." B is the girl reading a book on the sofa.

questions.zh: 「她在打電話」＝她正在講電話。F 是在公車站講手機的女生。
questions.en: "She is on the phone." F is the woman talking on her phone at the bus stop.

questions.zh: 「我的貓在睡覺」。C 是在椅子底下睡覺的貓。
questions.en: "My cat is sleeping." C is the cat asleep under the chair.

questions.zh: 「我想喝水」：A 是在喝水的男生。
questions.en: "I want to drink some water." A is the young man drinking water.

questions.zh: 「兒子喜歡吃米飯」。D 是拿筷子吃飯的男孩。
questions.en: "My son likes eating rice." D is the boy eating rice with chopsticks.

questions.zh: 問「你叫什麼名字？」，回答名字：「我叫王明。」
questions.en: "What's your name?" — "My name is Wang Ming."

questions.zh: 問「你幾點去學校？」，回答時間：「八點。」
questions.en: "What time do you go to school?" — "Eight o'clock."

questions.zh: 問「你是老師嗎？」，回答「不是，我是學生。」
questions.en: "Are you a teacher?" — "No, I'm a student."

questions.zh: 別人說「謝謝你！」，回答「不客氣。」
questions.en: "Thank you!" — "You're welcome."

questions.zh: 問「你媽媽在哪兒？」（你媽媽在哪裡），回答地點：「在家裡。」A「好的，謝謝！」是多出來的。
questions.en: "Where is your mother?" — "At home." A is the spare reply.

questions.zh: 說年紀用「歲」：我今年十八歲。
questions.en: Age takes 岁 (years old): I'm eighteen this year.

questions.zh: 書的量詞是「本」：這本書是我的。
questions.en: 本 is the measure word for books: this book is mine.

questions.zh: 形容詞前面加「很」：他今天很高興。
questions.en: 很 goes before an adjective: he's very happy today.

questions.zh: 「去」＋地方：我明天去北京。
questions.en: 去 + a place: I'm going to Beijing tomorrow.

questions.zh: 「開車」：我爸爸會開車。「叫」是多出來的。
questions.en: 开车 is to drive: my dad can drive. 叫 is the spare word.

items.text: 我家有三个人：爸爸、妈妈和我。

tr.en: There are three people in my family: dad, mum and me.

questions.zh: 「我家有三個人」：爸爸、媽媽和我，一共三個人。
questions.en: "There are three people in my family" — dad, mum and him.

items.text: 今天天气很冷，我不想去学校。

tr.en: It's very cold today; I don't want to go to school.

questions.zh: 「今天天氣很冷」，所以他不想去學校。
questions.en: "It's very cold today", so he doesn't want to go to school.

items.text: 我是中国人，现在在日本工作。

tr.en: I'm Chinese, and I'm working in Japan now.

questions.zh: 他是中國人，可是「現在在日本工作」。
questions.en: He is Chinese, but he "is working in Japan now".

items.text: 现在是下午三点，我们五点去看电影。

tr.en: It's three in the afternoon now; we're going to see a film at five.

questions.zh: 現在是三點，「我們五點去看電影」。
questions.en: It's three now; they "are going to see a film at five".

items.text: 王先生是医生，他的女儿是老师。

tr.en: Mr Wang is a doctor, and his daughter is a teacher.

questions.q: 王先生的女儿做什么工作？
questions.zh: 王先生是醫生，「他的女兒是老師」。
questions.en: Mr Wang is the doctor; "his daughter is a teacher".

panels: a mother cooking at the stove in a small kitchen
a father asleep in bed under a blanket
a boy writing Chinese characters in a notebook at a desk
a girl buying apples from a fruit seller at a shop
a small dog sitting in front of a house door
a family of three watching television on a sofa in the evening

questions.zh: 「媽媽在做飯」：A 是在廚房煮飯的媽媽。
questions.en: "Mum is cooking." A is the mother at the stove.

questions.zh: 「我想買幾個蘋果」：D 是在店裡買蘋果的女孩。
questions.en: "I'd like to buy a few apples." D is the girl buying apples.

questions.zh: 「他在寫漢字」：C 是在書桌前寫字的男孩。
questions.en: "He is writing Chinese characters." That is C.

questions.zh: 「我們晚上在家看電視」：F 是晚上一起看電視的一家人。
questions.en: "We watch TV at home in the evening." F is the family on the sofa.

questions.zh: 「爸爸還在睡覺呢」：B 是在床上睡覺的爸爸。E（小狗）是多出來的。
questions.en: "Dad is still asleep." B is the father in bed. E, the dog, is the spare picture.

questions.zh: 問「你好嗎？」，回答「很好，謝謝。」
questions.en: "How are you?" — "Very well, thanks."

questions.zh: 問「這個多少錢？」，回答價錢：「二十塊。」
questions.en: "How much is this?" — "Twenty kuai."

questions.zh: 問「你怎麼去學校？」，回答交通方式：「坐出租車。」
questions.en: "How do you get to school?" — "By taxi."

questions.zh: 問「今天星期幾？」，回答「星期三。」
questions.en: "What day is it today?" — "Wednesday."

questions.zh: 問「他是你哥哥嗎？」，回答「是的，他是我哥哥。」F「對不起，我不會。」是多出來的。
questions.en: "Is he your older brother?" — "Yes, he is." F is the spare reply.

questions.zh: 說自己是哪國人用「是」：我是中國人。
questions.en: 是 links you and your nationality: I am Chinese.

questions.zh: 問能力用「會」：你會說漢語嗎？
questions.en: 会 asks about a skill: can you speak Chinese?

questions.zh: 人的量詞用「個」：三個朋友。
questions.en: 个 is the measure word for people: three friends.

questions.zh: 「在」＋地方＋工作：我媽媽在醫院工作。
questions.en: 在 + a place + 工作: my mum works at a hospital.

questions.zh: 茶是用「喝」的：我喜歡喝茶。「也」是多出來的。
questions.en: You drink (喝) tea: I like drinking tea. 也 is the spare word.

items.text: 我女儿今年六岁，她很喜欢小狗。

tr.en: My daughter is six this year, and she loves puppies.

questions.zh: 「我女兒今年六歲」。
questions.en: "My daughter is six this year."

items.text: 我昨天去商店买了一些水果。

tr.en: Yesterday I went to the shop and bought some fruit.

questions.zh: 「我昨天去商店買了一些水果」：他去了商店。
questions.en: "Yesterday I went to the shop and bought some fruit."

items.text: 明天下雨，我们不去商店了，在家看书吧。

tr.en: It's going to rain tomorrow, so let's not go to the shops — let's stay home and read.

questions.zh: 下雨，所以「不去商店了，在家看書吧」。
questions.en: Because of the rain: "let's not go to the shops; let's stay home and read."

items.text: 李老师会说汉语，也会做中国菜。

tr.en: Ms Li speaks Chinese, and she can cook Chinese food too.

questions.zh: 「也會做中國菜」：李老師會做中國菜。
questions.en: "…and she can cook Chinese food too."

items.text: 你的书在桌子上，你的杯子在椅子下。

tr.en: Your book is on the table, and your cup is under the chair.

questions.zh: 書在桌子上，「杯子在椅子下」。
questions.en: The book is on the table; "your cup is under the chair".

panels: a man driving a car, seen through the side window
a girl holding a cup of tea and smiling
a student studying at a desk with an open textbook
an old woman walking in the rain under an umbrella
a man trying on a jacket that is much too big for him in a clothes shop
two friends eating together at a table in a restaurant

questions.zh: 「下雨了」：D 是撐著傘走在雨裡的老奶奶。
questions.en: "It's raining." D is the old woman under an umbrella.

questions.zh: 「這件衣服太大了」：E 是穿著太大外套的男人。
questions.en: "This jacket is too big." E is the man in the oversized jacket.

questions.zh: 「我們去飯店吃飯吧」：F 是在餐廳一起吃飯的兩個人。
questions.en: "Let's go and eat at a restaurant." That is F.

questions.zh: 「他在學習漢語」：C 是在書桌前念書的學生。
questions.en: "He is studying Chinese." C is the student at the desk.

questions.zh: 「我喜歡喝茶」：B 是拿著茶杯的女孩。A（開車）是多出來的。
questions.en: "I like drinking tea." B is the girl with the cup. A, the driver, is the spare picture.

questions.zh: 別人說「對不起！」，回答「沒關係。」
questions.en: "Sorry!" — "That's all right."

questions.zh: 問「你在做什麼呢？」，回答正在做的事：「我在看電影。」
questions.en: "What are you doing?" — "I'm watching a film."

questions.zh: 問「你喜歡吃米飯嗎？」，回答「喜歡，很好吃。」
questions.en: "Do you like rice?" — "Yes, it's delicious."

questions.zh: 問「他們是誰？」，回答「他們是我的同學。」
questions.en: "Who are they?" — "They're my classmates."

questions.zh: 問「你家在哪兒？」，回答地點：「在北京。」C「下午三點」是多出來的。
questions.en: "Where is your home?" — "In Beijing." C is the spare reply.

questions.zh: 初次見面說「很高興認識你」。
questions.en: On meeting someone: 很高兴认识你, nice to meet you.

questions.zh: 問數量用「多少」：你們學校有多少個學生？
questions.en: 多少 asks how many: how many students does your school have?

questions.zh: 東西放在桌面用「上」：在桌子上。
questions.en: 上 is on (top of): my computer is on the table.

questions.zh: 說自己的願望用「想」：我想喝茶。
questions.en: 想 says what you'd like: I'd like some tea.

questions.zh: 書的量詞是「本」：三本漢語書。「冷」是多出來的。
questions.en: 本 is the measure word for books: three Chinese books. 冷 is the spare word.

items.text: 我们学校有很多猫，我很喜欢它们。

tr.en: There are lots of cats at our school, and I really like them.

questions.zh: 學校有很多貓，「我很喜歡牠們」：他喜歡貓。
questions.en: There are many cats at school and "I really like them".

items.text: 王老师今天不在学校，她病了。

tr.en: Ms Wang isn't at school today; she is ill.

questions.zh: 「她病了」，所以今天不在學校。
questions.en: "She is ill", so she isn't at school today.

items.text: 这本书是我在商店买的，三十块钱。

tr.en: I bought this book at a shop; it was thirty kuai.

questions.zh: 「三十塊錢」。
questions.en: "Thirty kuai."

items.text: 我早上七点起床，八点去学校。

tr.en: I get up at seven in the morning and go to school at eight.

questions.zh: 七點起床，「八點去學校」。
questions.en: He gets up at seven and "goes to school at eight".

items.text: 小张喜欢喝茶，不喜欢喝水。

tr.en: Xiao Zhang likes drinking tea but not water.

questions.zh: 「小張喜歡喝茶」，不喜歡喝水。
questions.en: "Xiao Zhang likes drinking tea", not water.

panels: a cat and a dog sitting side by side on a rug
a father cooking a pot of rice in the kitchen
a girl writing with a pencil at a table; her notebook page shows faint wavy lines only, no characters, no letters
a man reading a book on a bus
students in a classroom listening to their teacher
a man drinking a glass of water under a hot summer sun

questions.zh: 「我家有貓，也有狗」：A 是坐在一起的貓和狗。
questions.en: "We have a cat and a dog too." That is A.

questions.zh: 「爸爸在做米飯」：B 是在廚房煮飯的爸爸。
questions.en: "Dad is cooking rice." B is the father in the kitchen.

questions.zh: 「她在寫字」：C 是拿鉛筆寫字的女孩。
questions.en: "She is writing." C is the girl with the pencil.

questions.zh: 「學生們在聽老師說話」：E 是上課的教室。
questions.en: "The students are listening to the teacher." That is E.

questions.zh: 「天氣太熱了，我想喝水」：F 是在大太陽下喝水的男人。D（在公車上看書）是多出來的。
questions.en: "It's too hot; I want some water." F is the man drinking in the sun. D is the spare picture.

questions.zh: 問「你是哪國人？」，回答國籍：「我是日本人。」
questions.en: "Where are you from?" — "I'm Japanese."

questions.zh: 問「你家有幾個人？」，回答人數：「五個。」
questions.en: "How many people are in your family?" — "Five."

questions.zh: 問「你什麼時候去北京？」，回答時間：「明天上午。」
questions.en: "When are you going to Beijing?" — "Tomorrow morning."

questions.zh: 別人給你看新衣服，回答「很漂亮。」
questions.en: "Look, these are my new clothes." — "They're lovely."

questions.zh: 別人說「我們去吃飯吧！」，回答「好的，我們去吧。」E「很好吃」是多出來的。
questions.en: "Let's go and eat!" — "OK, let's go." E is the spare reply.

questions.zh: 說家在哪裡用「住」：我住在北京。
questions.en: 住 is to live: I live in Beijing.

questions.zh: 說錢用「塊」：十塊錢。
questions.en: 块 counts money: ten kuai.

questions.zh: 搭交通工具用「坐」：坐飛機去上海。
questions.en: 坐 is to take (a plane, a bus): we're flying to Shanghai.

questions.zh: 問時間：現在幾點了？
questions.en: 几点 asks the time: what time is it now?

questions.zh: 「和」＝跟：我和媽媽去商店。「讀」是多出來的。
questions.en: 和 is and / with: I'm going to the shop with my mum. 读 is the spare word.

items.text: 今天是星期六，我不去学校，在家看电视。

tr.en: It's Saturday today; I'm not going to school — I'm watching TV at home.

questions.zh: 星期六不去學校，「在家看電視」。
questions.en: No school on Saturday: he is "watching TV at home".

items.text: 我想去北京看我的朋友，他在那儿工作。

tr.en: I want to go to Beijing to see my friend; he works there.

questions.zh: 「我想去北京看我的朋友」：工作的是他的朋友。
questions.en: "I want to go to Beijing to see my friend" — it's the friend who works there.

items.text: 这是我的老师，她是李老师，是北京人。

tr.en: This is my teacher, Ms Li; she is from Beijing.

questions.zh: 「是北京人」。
questions.en: "She is from Beijing."

items.text: 我儿子会说汉语，不会写汉字。

tr.en: My son can speak Chinese but can't write characters.

questions.zh: 會說漢語，「不會寫漢字」。
questions.en: He can speak Chinese but "can't write characters".

items.text: 昨天很冷，今天不冷了，很热。

tr.en: Yesterday was cold; today it isn't — it's hot.

questions.zh: 昨天很冷，「今天不冷了，很熱」。
questions.en: Yesterday was cold; "today it isn't — it's hot".
